jobDescription:
Principal Distributed Systems Architect

Requirements:
- 10+ years of software architecture experience in large-scale distributed systems
- Proven leadership migrating monolithic architectures to distributed event-driven systems
- Deep database internals expertise with Cassandra or DynamoDB NoSQL engines at scale
- Demonstrated track record filing technology patents or authoring technical white papers
- Production experience with Apache Kafka clusters handling petabyte-scale streaming data
resumeText:
Dr. Eleanor Vance, Ph.D.
Principal Distributed Systems Architect | Fellow
Email: eleanor.vance@systems-research.org | Location: Seattle, WA

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Distinguished systems architect with 16 years of industry and academic leadership designing globally distributed, fault-tolerant platforms. Author of 4 systems patents in distributed consensus and eventual consistency. Veteran architect across Fortune 500 enterprises handling petabyte-scale real-time telemetry.

AREAS OF EXPERTISE
Distributed Systems Architecture, CAP Theorem Trade-offs, Event-Driven Architecture, High-Availability Systems, NoSQL Database Internals, Consensus Protocols (Raft, Paxos), Stream Processing, Multi-Region Active-Active Replication, Large-Scale Monolith Decomposition.

PATENTS & PUBLICATIONS
- US Patent 10,845,912: 'Adaptive Partitioning and Rebalancing in Distributed Key-Value Stores' (Issued 2021)
- US Patent 9,762,451: 'Dynamic Sharding and Latency Mitigation in Wide-Column Datastores' (Issued 2018)
- Vance, E. et al. 'Petabyte-Scale Stream Processing: Architectural Patterns and Operational Retrospective.' ACM Queue, 2022.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Principal Enterprise Architect | GlobalScale Cloud | 2019 - Present
- Led multi-year architectural transformation decommissioning a 14-year-old monolithic billing engine into an event-driven distributed system powered by Apache Kafka, serving 85 million active accounts.
- Architected and operated multi-datacenter Apache Kafka clusters processing 4.2 petabytes of telemetry per day with sub-second replication latency.
- Managed global Apache Cassandra database clusters spanning 12 AWS regions, designing custom consistent hashing strategies to eliminate hotspotting under peak seasonal traffic spikes of 350,000 writes/second.
- Mentored 40+ staff and senior engineers across distributed systems fundamentals, failure mode analysis, and chaos engineering.

Lead Infrastructure Architect | DataMesh Networks | 2014 - 2019
- Designed distributed key-value storage engine utilizing Raft consensus protocol for metadata coordination across 2,000 bare-metal nodes.
- Replaced legacy relational database with Apache Cassandra for high-velocity IoT time-series ingestion, reducing storage infrastructure cost by 60%.
- Established company-wide disaster recovery and active-active failover protocols with verified zero data loss during regional outages.

Senior Software Engineer | HighVelocity Systems | 2008 - 2014
- Implemented high-throughput network transport layer in C++ and Java with zero-copy buffer pools.
- Optimized distributed lock manager algorithms, reducing contention deadlocks by 85%.

EDUCATION
Ph.D. in Computer Science (Distributed Systems) | MIT | 2008
B.S. in Computer Science & Applied Mathematics | Stanford University | 2004
